fontFamily.$description: Choose a font family by content role: long-form prose, application interface text, or code.

prose.$description: Use for long-form reading content, such as articles and documentation. Do not use for application controls or code.

ui.$description: Use for text in application interfaces, including controls, labels, and navigation. Do not use for long-form reading or code.

code.$description: Use for source code, commands, and other content whose character alignment must be preserved. Do not use for prose or general interface text.
